issues.reason: (Location (sk_face $x) prison) is false — the facing eventuality does not occur in a prison; "in prison" modifies the penalty NP, and Location is the event oblique answering "where" the event happens.
(MeasureAtMost (sk_face $x) duration 2 year) is false — a duration measure states the eventuality's own extent, and the text bounds the prison term faced, not the length of the facing.

Status predicates require the marker to be read off the clause ("Mark otherwise", "never by feel"), and the instruction set renders "would V" as Future ("it would rain" -> (Future sk_rain_1)), so a consequent with no status atom drops a marked one.

gaps_confirmed: A penalty NP as the object of "face" ("face up to two years in prison") has no licensed slot: neither the bounded duration nor the custodial institution belongs to the facing event.
Irrealis "would" under a proposed instrument — Future carries only the temporal half; nothing carries the hypothetical/conditional force.
new_gaps: A verb that carries out an occurrence-denoting object ("perform the procedure") is not settled by the object-change test, which names only verbs that change whether/when an occurrence happens (cancel, postpone) — Theme vs Patient is left open.
repair_summary: Removed the false (Location (sk_face $x) prison) atom; removed the false (MeasureAtMost (sk_face $x) duration 2 year) atom; added (Future (sk_face $x)) for the dropped "would" marker.
notes: The penalty content ("up to two years in prison") is dropped rather than re-slotted, since no licensed carrier exists and inventing one is barred. The rule routing, relative-clause premises, definite projections and the (Under ... sk_bill_1) framing oblique are all licensed and untouched.
